title: Velo Freezing Peppermint Slim Nicotine Pouches
description: Velo Slim Freezing Peppermint Nicotine Pouches deliver a powerful Peppermint flavour sharpened by an icy menthol chill, creating a profile that tastes striking, cool and invigorating. This is one of the coldest blends in the Velo range, offering a mint experience designed for those who enjoy a bracing pouch flavour. Each can contains 20 slim pouches made from plant-based fibres, designed for a discreet and comfortable fit under the lip. Nicotine is released steadily without smoke, vapour or odour, making them an easy and practical choice at any time. Produced in Europe, Velo nicotine pouches are available in a wide variety of flavours and strengths. Freezing Peppermint comes in three Strong options: 10.9mg for a robust release, 14mg for a more forceful nicotine hit, and 17mg for those who prefer the most potent experience in the series. Nicotine Ranges: Mellow - 4mg to 6mg this is best for new users. Original - 6mg to 11mg this is best for regular users. Intense - 8mg to 17mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Place one pouch under your upper lip and leave it in place for 20–40 minutes while the flavour and nicotine release gradually. When finished, remove the pouch and dispose of it responsibly. Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
